After a long journey, you’ve arrived in
Lumiose City! But a Pokémon named
Pancham has run off with your bag...
Chase after it to reclaim your belongings!

The city changes a lot when the sun goes
down. Find your way out of this “battle zone”
and retreat to the safety of Hotel Z with the
